messages:
Leah: Quick ops thread — acceptance & waitlist SOP. We're seeing too many confirmed partners drop late. Need a compact, repeatable flow so cohorts don't stall.
Tom: Proposed constraints: 1) 72-hour confirmation hold after offer, 2) require booking of onboarding call in that window, 3) two automated reminders at 48h and 16h, 4) if booking not completed -> mark "needs outreach" and ping CSM.
Aisha: From infra: we need a 5-business-day lead for anything that touches infra allocation (GPU pools, VPC routes). If confirm <5 business days before start, we should either move cohort date or accept as no-guarantee for infra changes.
Devon: To reduce no-shows, add an explicit pre-kickoff checklist step: repo access, sample data, and contact for SRE. Only those who complete checklist get "confirmed" status in dashboard.
ben-csm-bot: Reminder templates ready.
- 48h: "Reminder: confirm your pilot slot and schedule your onboarding call: [link]"
- 16h: "Final reminder to confirm or your slot will be released in ~16 hours."
- Post-decline: "Thanks for the update — would you like to join the waitlist? (Quick reason: timing / scope / budget / other)"
Leah: What about a short SLA for replacements? target: fill released slot within 72h, ideally 48h. If replacement requires infra changes, tag and escalate to eng on-call.
Tom: Intake form additions: boolean "needs infra" and quick fields for preferred window + expected token volume. That helps scheduling and capacity planning.
Aisha: Agree. Also, implement a gating flag so waitlist replacements that require infra are only allowed if start date >= 7 days out. Prevent late scramble.
Devon: CSM play: 1) automatic schedule step (Calendly) in acceptance flow, 2) if not scheduled in 24h, a human follow-up. After 2 failed contact attempts, release slot.
Leah: Incentive structure: keep it simple in messaging — up-front credit + success bonus after completion. Call out approximate time commitment. Transparency reduces drop rate.
Tom: Metrics to track: offer -> accept rate, accept -> scheduled (target 90%), scheduled -> attended (target 95%), confirmed -> completed (target 70%), time-to-fill on slot release. Also log decline reasons as categories.
Aisha: Add an "at-risk" flag on candidates who accept but don't finish checklist or don't schedule. Use it to prioritize outreach.
Devon: Implementation notes: add a dashboard column for "requires infra" and "checklist status". Hook alerts for slots that need manual ops.
Leah: Workflow summary for rollout:
1) Offer sent -> 72h soft hold with 48h + 16h reminders.
2) Must book onboarding call in that window. Missing booking -> CSM outreach; 2 failed attempts -> release.
3) If decline -> ask reason + opt-in waitlist. If waitlist candidate, run 3-point intake checklist before swap.
4) Replacements: aim to fill in 48h, hard limit 72h. If "needs infra" -> require >=7 days lead or escalate to eng.
Tom: Can I own the Calendly + reminder automation? Devon: I'll add the intake checklist and dashboard flags. Aisha: I'll wire the infra boolean and escalation rules. Leah: I'll draft the acceptance & decline language and circulate by EOD for 24h feedback.
Leah: If everyone OK, target: run a compact cohort using this flow next week and measure drop rate. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
